scope: Recovery of takes interrupted by a process crash: core recoverTake() and the desktop's journal, interrupted-take listing and Recover takes
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image (Qt 6.12, PipeWire 1.6.9, libsndfile 1.2.2), docker --network none, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen
verified_behaviors: A take whose process was SIGKILLed mid-recording recovers bit for bit against independently generated blocks
The .part file is byte-identical after recovery and an existing destination is never replaced
A copy cut mid-frame recovers its whole frames and reports the discarded bytes
Incomplete header, garbage, empty data and 16-bit PCM files are refused with reasons and left unchanged
After a real desktop crash while recording, opening the project lists the take with its journal and track
Recover takes adds a selected Recovered take clip in one Undo step; Undo keeps the file; the .part file and journal go only after full read-back
A take without a journal is recovered to a kept file and not placed; an unrecoverable file stays listed and unchanged
limits: Recovery after process crashes only; power loss can leave unwritten extents zero-filled by the filesystem, which recovery keeps as silence and cannot detect. No device-loss finalization (#46). Offscreen QML and preview audio; the core test supplies non-silent content.
